card.name: Start of words beginning with Pre or Im
card.fires_on: The word-start piece "Pre" or "Im" (often capitalized) that begins a longer word such as prepare, preparation, prep, implant, imipramine or imidazoles, mostly in drug label text.

modes.label: Pre- words
modes.description: "Pre" or "PRE" starting words like prepared, preparing, preparations, bowel prep.

modes.label: Im- words
modes.description: "Im" starting drug or device names such as implant, imipramine, imidazoles.

card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of long words that start with Pre or Im, like prepare or imipramine.
